第一条: Article 1  This Law is formulated in accordance with the Constitution in order to protect the rights and interests in personal information, to standardise personal information processing activities, and to promote the reasonable use of personal information.
第二条: Article 2  The personal information of a natural person is protected by law, and no organisation or individual may infringe a natural person’s rights and interests in their personal information.
第四条:
Article 4  “Personal information” means all kinds of information, recorded electronically or by other means, relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, excluding information that has been anonymised.

The processing of personal information includes its collection, storage, use, handling, transmission, provision, disclosure and deletion.
第五条: Article 5  The processing of personal information shall follow the principles of lawfulness, legitimacy, necessity and good faith; personal information may not be processed by means of misleading, fraud, coercion or the like.
第六条:
Article 6  The processing of personal information shall have a clear and reasonable purpose, shall be directly related to that purpose, and shall employ the means having the least impact on the rights and interests of the individual.

The collection of personal information shall be limited to the minimum scope necessary to achieve the processing purpose; personal information may not be collected excessively.
第七条: Article 7  The processing of personal information shall follow the principles of openness and transparency: the rules for processing personal information shall be made public, and the purpose, means and scope of the processing shall be expressly stated.
第八条: Article 8  The processing of personal information shall ensure the quality of that information, so as to avoid adverse effects on the rights and interests of the individual arising from personal information that is inaccurate or incomplete.
第九条: Article 9  A personal information processor shall be responsible for its personal information processing activities and shall adopt the necessary measures to safeguard the security of the personal information it processes.
第十条: Article 10  No organisation or individual may unlawfully collect, use, handle or transmit another person’s personal information, or unlawfully trade in, provide or disclose another person’s personal information; nor may any organisation or individual engage in personal information processing activities endangering national security or the public interest.
第十一条: Article 11  The State shall establish and improve a personal information protection system, prevent and punish conduct infringing rights and interests in personal information, strengthen publicity and education on personal information protection, and foster a sound environment in which government, enterprises, relevant social organisations and the public jointly participate in personal information protection.
第十二条: Article 12  The State shall actively participate in the formulation of international rules on personal information protection, promote international exchange and cooperation on personal information protection, and advance mutual recognition of personal information protection rules and standards with other countries, regions and international organisations.
